title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
summary: David Silver and colleagues published Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search online in Nature on January 27, 2016. The paper described AlphaGo, combining policy and value neural networks with Monte Carlo tree search, and reported that the system defeated European Go champion Fan Hui by five games to zero.
significance: A documented reinforcement-learning and game-playing milestone in which a deep-neural-network system defeated a professional Go player in full-sized Go.

verification.note: Nature's article record establishes the title, authors, online publication date of January 27 2016, AlphaGo's policy/value-network and tree-search approach, and the reported 5-0 match result against European Go champion Fan Hui. Google Research independently preserves the publication and abstract. The record is a publication milestone; it does not infer a separate system-birth date or causal relationship to later systems.
